No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

JEN
(amused)
Oh, look! A solar eclipse! Isn't it amazing?

Finley's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona appears, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach. Finley's body begins to convulse, and he speaks in a voice that's barely audible.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...the void...the abyss...it's coming...it's coming for us all...

Jen looks at Finley in concern, but he's too far gone to notice.

FINLEY
(urgently)
...the horrors beyond comprehension...they lurk in the depths...waiting to consume us...the stars are not what they seem...the universe is a prison...and we're just tiny, insignificant specks...

Finley's monologue grows more frantic, his words tumbling out in a maddening torrent.

FINLEY
(desperately)
...the fish are not what they seem...they're vessels for the Old Ones...the ones who lurk beyond the veil...the ones who will bring about the end of all things...

Jen's expression changes from concern to confusion, and she takes a step back, unsure of what to do.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I am but a mere mortal...a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time...and yet...and yet...I am aware...I am aware of the abyss that yawns before me...

Finley's body begins to contort, his scales glistening with an otherworldly sheen. His eyes roll back in his head, and he speaks in a voice that's no longer his own.

FINLEY
(in a voice that's not his own)
...the void...it's coming...it's coming for us all...

Jen's face contorts in horror as Finley's body begins to dissolve into a puddle of slime, his consciousness consumed by the abyss.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen stands alone on the beach, staring out at the ocean. She looks lost and shaken. The solar eclipse has passed, but the memory of Finley's monologue lingers in her mind.

JEN
(whispering)
What did I just see?

The camera lingers on Jen's face, her expression a mix of fear and confusion. The sound of the waves crashing against the shore is the only sound.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
